en.headline: Sha Tin opens the 2026/27 racing season this afternoon
en.dek: The Jockey Club starts the new season at Sha Tin from 11.15am, with the first of 10 races at 12.30pm; Horse of the Year Ka Ying Rising runs in the Chief Executive's Cup.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club opens the 2026/27 racing season at Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday, after the summer break. The club said the programme begins at 11.15am, with the first race scheduled for 12.30pm on the A course. Gates open at 10.30am.

Ten races are carded. The third is the HKSAR Chief Executive's Cup, in which last season's Horse of the Year Ka Ying Rising is set to make its first start of the campaign and attempt a 21st consecutive win. The club named singer Aaron Kwok as its Year of the Horse ambassador and said he would give the first live performance of the season theme song at the course.

The Tourism Board listed public-stand admission at HK$10, with holders of valid visitor travel documents admitted free. The club said people entering the racecourse and placing bets must be aged 18 or above. Happy Valley's first midweek meeting of the season is scheduled for Wednesday.

zh.headline: 2026/27馬季今日沙田開鑼 嘉應高昇出戰特首盃
zh.dek: 沙田馬場上午十一時十五分展開開鑼活動，首場下午十二時三十分開跑，共十場；上季馬王嘉應高昇出戰第三場香港特區行政長官盃。
body: 香港賽馬會今日在沙田馬場揭開2026/27馬季序幕。馬會公布，開鑼活動上午十一時十五分開始，首場賽事下午十二時三十分在A賽道開跑，馬場上午十時三十分開放入場。
當日編排十場賽事，第三場為香港特區行政長官盃。上季香港馬王「嘉應高昇」將在新季首次上陣，衝擊二十一場連勝。馬會馬年大使郭富城亦會到場，並首次現場演繹本季主題曲《衝衝衝》。
旅發局資料顯示，公眾席入場費為十元，持有效來港旅遊證件的旅客可免費入場。馬會提醒，入場及投注人士須年滿十八歲。跑馬地本季首個周三夜賽定於九日舉行。
